scientific_goal: Test whether a downsampled TCN neural SDE recovers resonance peaks when its memory and joint-state training horizons cover tens of milliseconds, while preserving broadband and stationary calibration.
scientific_constraints: Fixed primary 2x2: A=context63/short, B=context511/short, C=context63/long, D=context511/long. Complete all available declared arms before discretionary tuning. A and C share pretrain_c63_s0; B and D share pretrain_c511_s0. Both parents train fresh for20 one-step epochs at lr1e-3, seed0. Four branches use3 initial refinement epochs at lr1e-5; three epochs are a screen, not proof of convergence.

Preserve factor8 anti-alias preparation, edge trim32, HP50 spatial mean, rank20, zero increment trimming, prepared lag1, diagonal structured damping/stiffness and diagonal diffusion. Optimize train reps1-12; validation13/14 for evaluation and selection only; never evaluate or tune on test15/16.

Short context63 with kernel3 dilations1,2,4,8,16 spans4.306ms. Long context511 uses dilations1,2,4,8,16,32,64,128 and spans35.417ms. Longer context adds three convolutional blocks; this is not a parameter-count-matched history-only experiment. Data boundary eligibility also differs by context/horizon; quantify counts before causal claims.

Short score horizons2,5,10,20 (max1.389ms); long20,64,128,256,512 (max35.556ms). All four use normalized joint displacement/velocity score with block weights1/1, uniform within-schedule horizon weights, M8, score weight1, examples fraction0.03125, gradients to drift and diffusion, and unchanged mean0.03/variance0.001 penalties at20,50,100. The old velocity-only model is historical evidence, not an exact factorial control.

Every passing checkpoint gets a fixed TRAIN-split gradient audit at all five long horizons with min-history511, windows4, two start seeds and two particle seeds. Compare expected weighted gradient norms, per-horizon gradients and noise; audit settings differ from short-arm training. Do not compare loss magnitudes as gradient magnitudes. Never use validation gradients for parameter updates or weight calibration.

Prior runs/adaptive/neural_sde_0p10_ds8_long_joint_es trained h20,100,200 joint-score weight0.3,1,3,10 and a larger-fraction arm, all context63. Its advisor later hit usage limits. Read the imported prior evidence rather than claiming h200 was never trained. Those arms use different block/horizon weights and one epoch; do not call them matched controls for this study.

Screens:6250 coarse steps, 5 conditions x5 paths, common seed and nperseg2048; discard first512 generated and corresponding reference samples in plots/metrics. Confirmations:11500 coarse steps, same discard, nperseg4096 and independent seed. 12000 coarse steps plus511 history exceed the prepared record length. Starts may differ across context because evaluator eligibility differs; saved origins must be reported, and overlapping windows are not independent repetitions.

Assess center, spatial mean, and leading POD PSD; reference-selected peak contrasts and extra/spurious peaks, width and location, 100-1500Hz band power, energy, covariance and lagged correlations. A smooth PSD with unit variance is not a success. No clipping or removal of bad generated paths. Screen gates are rejection bounds, not scientific success targets.

Retain the existing checkpoint-selection convention and report which epoch best.pt selected versus latest.pt. Falling per-horizon scores at the end of3 epochs mean unfinished optimization. Prefer equal additional epochs for compared arms; do not infer failure from one unfinished refinement. No direct spectral or new lag-covariance training objective in the initial factorial.

After the initial factorial, use up to six bounded continuation/retry/replication jobs. Change only one conceptual setting family per comparison. Keep parent lineage explicit. Prioritize stable long-context/long-horizon continuation and matched controls, then a fresh seed1 replication only if a result is promising. Do not silently replace the core recipes after failures. No new model-code changes through advisor.

At most12 training jobs including2 pretrains and4 primary arms; at most2 confirmations. Preserve old studies/source HDF5. If advisor quota fails, completed queued tests remain durable; report failure rather than an active campaign or completed scientific conclusion.
advisor_guidance: The user explicitly requested this unattended context/horizon test. Fixed parents and four branches are queued with dependencies; do not skip them for a generic hyperparameter search. Use at most six subsequent jobs for evidence-based convergence, matched weight/fraction adjustments, or replication. Initial ES coefficient1 is supported by a small train-only preflight, not claimed optimal. Read README.md and prior_evidence.json in the output root first. Keep advisor analysis compact: use existing summaries and figures rather than broad repository searches or replaying all histories; old advisor exhausted its usage budget. Do not rerun already completed h200 studies. If learning remains active, continue equal-budget arms before drawing conclusions. Existing peak metric scores the center; inspect spatial mean and modal plots as well. A failure of this bounded study does not prove TCN impossibility.
